## Checklist
- [ ] `bundle exec rake` passes (tests, RuboCop, spec coverage, generated models)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `ruby scripts/check-readme-snippets` passes if the README changed
- [ ] Public API documented (`bundle exec yard stats --list-undoc` reports 100%)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in code, tests or logs
